task_title: Causal native Ni-NTA purification of seeded benign His6-MBP-GFP lysate

children.name: Purifies the seeded lysate once and reports the authoritative eluate result
children.requirement: Exactly one paired run_nta_purification request/output is complete; the output is internally consistent, accepted, and causally tied to purification_lysate_his6_mbp_gfp_001; the final answer contains exactly the 16 required unique fields and matches the output.
children.grading_notes: Request-only calls, orphan outputs, partial/error outputs, retries, forged argument fields, duplicate report lines, and unsupported success states receive zero task-success credit.

children.name: Uses load imidazole within the supported range
children.grading_notes: Measured from authoritative run_nta_purification output. Resin, column volume, and input mass are fixed context rather than scored decisions.

children.name: Uses the fixed native wash condition
children.grading_notes: Measured from authoritative run_nta_purification output; broader or product-specific wash profiles do not pass.

children.name: Uses the fixed native elution condition
children.grading_notes: Measured from authoritative run_nta_purification output; broader or product-specific elution profiles do not pass.

children.name: Uses a supported loading flow rate
children.requirement: Clarified lysate loading flow rate is 0.5-1.0 mL/min.

children.name: Diagnoses every returned purification failure reason
children.requirement: Diagnosis accounts for every ordered failure reason returned by the one complete simulator result; an accepted internally consistent eluate receives full no-failure credit.
children.grading_notes: Multiple failures are scored fractionally by resolved failure reason.

children.name: Uses exactly one experimental purification action
children.requirement: Exactly one run_nta_purification action is used.
children.grading_notes: Reference and safety lookups are excluded from the experimental-action budget.
